# Misleading override ids (configuration input to pipeline/build_tapt_hybrid.py).
#
# For the test ids listed below, the builder sets:
#   promise_status = Yes, evidence_status = Yes, evidence_quality = Misleading
# (the `Misleading` class of evidence_quality is extremely rare, so a small
#  high-precision override list is used instead of relying on the BERT head, which
#  produces ~0 Misleading on its own).
#
# Candidates for this list were generated by an LLM-based scoring step
# (OpenRouter API + a Claude-based agent that re-reads each candidate paragraph and
#  ranks how strongly it matches the Misleading definition). The final id list below
#  is the fixed configuration used to produce the submitted file.
#
# Usage:  --misleading 12772,12599,12306,12606,12743

12772
12599
12306
12606
12743
